verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms a documented public Gemini API exists with defined parameters (temperature, top_k) and published pricing tiers, and is actively used by developers (e.g., AI Studio, benchmarking) — implying programmatic, API-driven access. However, none of the first-party evidence in this pack documents the API itself (no API reference, SDK, or endpoint docs are cited), since the docs pack focuses entirely on consumer Gemini Apps features rather than developer API documentation. Missing for 10: first-party API reference/docs citations, SDK/authentication details, and independent corroboration of API completeness beyond pricing/parameter gripes.
